answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works by forcing identities to establish a persistent presence on a shared canyon ledger before gaining weight. Each agent must climb a verification knoll where peers confirm its unique behavior pattern, and only those who successfully guide a sparrow-like lightweight probe through distinct path checks receive full voting power. Attackers face high cost because fabricating many such verified climbs requires ongoing compute and unique data trails that cannot be cheaply cloned.
